text: {"lessons":["I should set clear reasons and limits for each position, so I don't let reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a losing stock too long.","A large gain can be worth protecting, but I should decide how much to sell based on my plan rather than the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","I should judge trades by their effect on my whole portfolio and long-term goals, not by one month's account-value change."]}
